purpose: Reconcile two explicit user-authored DPG working-stock assertions with the current V5 snapshot without converting a note into an exact stock, preparation receipt, or experiment authorization.

reconciliation_policy.positive_evidence_rule: An exact current inventory line may establish only that the user asserted a named working stock, strength text, carrier text, date text, or parent relation text.
reconciliation_policy.negative_evidence_rule: An inventory comment is not a bottle image, lot record, ExactStockRef, measured preparation record, or supplier receipt and cannot close a missing witness.
reconciliation_policy.conflict_rule: When V5 omits or weakens a user assertion, preserve both states in an additive reconciliation and leave the canonical parent unchanged until its own governed update.
reconciliation_policy.execution_rule: No working stock is experiment-ready until stock identity, concentration basis, parent lineage, carrier, and preparation or supplier witnesses are jointly bound.

inventory_assertion.exact_text: - 2-Acetyl Pyrazine (1% in DPG)  # added 2026-07-29; popcorn/bread-crust/roasted gourmand stock

snapshot_state.actual_stocks: 2-Acetyl Pyrazine neat/as supplied; 1% working stock (carrier not stated)

positive_truth: The current inventory text explicitly names a 1% working stock in DPG.
The V5 snapshot independently preserves that a neat stock and a separate 1% working stock are asserted.
The inventory statement narrows the snapshot's carrier state from unstated to user-asserted DPG in this additive layer.
negative_truth: No exact working-stock identifier is bound.
No bottle-label or lot witness is bound.
No 1% basis such as w/w, v/v, or other basis is stated.
No measured preparation quantities, parent stock ID, or preparation receipt is bound.
The assertion does not authorize physical use or mutation of the V5 snapshot.

inventory_assertion.exact_text: - Lemonile (1% in DPG)  # diluted 2026-05-25 from neat stock; for micro-dose citrus lift in cologne styles

positive_truth: The current inventory text explicitly names a 1% Lemonile working stock in DPG.
The text asserts a dilution date of 2026-05-25 and a relation to a neat parent stock.
The V5 snapshot independently preserves the asserted neat Lemonile stock.
negative_truth: The V5 snapshot does not represent the claimed 1% working stock.
The inventory date and parent relation are user assertions, not a complete preparation receipt.
No exact neat-parent or working-stock identifiers, bottle labels, lots, measured quantities, or concentration basis are bound.
The assertion does not authorize physical use or mutation of the V5 snapshot.

literature_context.citation: Estimating the relationship between liquid- and vapor-phase odorant concentrations using a photoionization detector (PID)-based approach
literature_context.finding: Across odorants diluted in five solvents including dipropylene glycol, liquid and vapor concentrations could deviate from proportionality because of odorant-solvent interactions; a liquid 1% statement therefore does not establish vapor exposure.

literature_context.citation: Chemosensory Event-Related Potentials in Response to Nasal Propylene Glycol Stimulation
literature_context.finding: The paper studies propylene glycol, not dipropylene glycol; it therefore cannot establish DPG neutrality, the identity of either local carrier, or local stock readiness.

literature_context.citation: Prediction models for the pleasantness of binary mixtures in olfaction
literature_context.finding: Binary-mixture pleasantness prediction required constituent psychophysics at relevant concentrations and separated pleasantness from intensity.

literature_context.citation: A dataset on odor intensity and odor pleasantness of 222 binary mixtures of 72 key food odorants rated by a sensory panel of 30 trained assessors
literature_context.finding: The dataset records mixture and component attributes separately and checks repeatability using duplicated trials; it does not validate these local stocks.
The standard governs threshold data and error bounds, not recognition thresholds, personal stock identity, or preparation lineage.

sol_corrections: The Lemonile working-stock assertion is on inventory.txt line 35, not line 34.
The inventory comment is a user assertion and is not accepted as a preparation receipt.
No snapshot mutation or physical execution follows from the recovered carrier text.

minimum_evidence: One distinct ExactStockRef for each neat and 1% working stock
Bottle-label or lot witness for each physical stock
Measured preparation quantities and preparation record, or exact supplier lineage for a purchased dilution
